api.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test

limits: Browser fixtures do not validate real platform credentials or data reconciliation.
Permission checks exercise demo roles, not real nominal-account credentials.
Geometry/name checks and keyboard tests do not establish full WCAG certification or real screen-reader behavior.
No mutations persisted; role and brand changes are browser-local demo cookies.
Actual Nexus HTTP handler and one full mobile UI exchange; snapshot data is simulated.
Only critical/monthly gates are fixture responses; Nexus responses are not intercepted.
No advertising-platform reads or persisted record changes.
Nominal logins and read-only application queries; no advertising-platform reads or reconciliation.
Login audit entries are recorded; passwords and cookies remain in memory and are never emitted.
No new advertising-platform reads, reconciliation, deployment or production acceptance.
Unit transports and browser write/error paths use fixtures; actual Nexus local handler uses mock metrics.
No full WCAG certification; no production Netlify Blobs or distributed-process guarantee.
Secrets, cookies, authentication headers, OAuth bodies and signed report URLs are excluded from evidence.
